[[File:Thruster.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A Nebulon-Q thruster jet on a skyspeeder.]]
The '''Nebulon-Q thruster jet''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] manufactured by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]]. The [[Cloud-Riders/Legends|Cloud-Riders]] from [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]] used Nebulon-Q [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] to customize their [[skyspeeder]]s.
